sam.sre: Heads-up: emergency control-plane TLS cert rotation scheduled for eu-central-1 and ap-south-1 tomorrow 2024-09-10 01:30-02:00 UTC. This is to replace a CA path that expires earlier than expected. Expect 1-2 minute windows of short TCP reconnects for streaming sessions; REST calls should be retried automatically.
nina.net: Any customer impact for Dedicated or Private (VPC)?
sam.sre: Dedicated: zero config change, but tenants with strict mTLS pinning that pinned CA will be impacted. Private (air-gapped) customers not affected unless they asked us to rotate certs there. We'll email tenants with pinned certs.
paul.ops: Canary plan? rollback strategy? Who's owner during the window?
sam.sre: Canary: start in eu-central at 01:25 UTC (5m), then ap-south at 01:35 if green. Owner: @oncall will own the rollout. Rollback if >2% increase in 5m client errors OR control-plane auth errors >0.5% above baseline for >3m. Manual stop: `#/maintenance cancel rot-20240910`
cert-rotator-bot: Rotation job scheduled -> rot-20240910, targets=[eu-central-1,ap-south-1], initiator=sam.sre
ops-bot: Calendar updated: Control-plane maintenance (rot-20240910) added to maintenance page.
maria.mgmt: Please put a short note in the infra-status page and notify partner integrations team (they maintain long-lived webhooks).
paul.ops: Excluding loadtests? We have a perf run in eu-central at 02:00 UTC (outside but close).
sam.sre: Yes exclude `test-mode=true` traffic and tag `loadtest`. If you're running a test within +/-15m, pls reschedule.
oncall: Runbook excerpt pasted below. I'll be on the bridge and watching dashboards (token-auth-errors, controlplane-latency/p99, stream-drop-rate).
```
# Oncall runbook Control-plane TLS rotation
1) Pre-checks (T-30m): ensure canary nodes healthy, backup certs available
2) Start canary eu-central at 01:25 UTC. Observe controlplane-latency/p99 and auth-error-rate/1m
3) If canary passes (no auth errors, latency stable) -> proceed to ap-south canary 01:35
4) If auth-error-rate >0.5% for >3m OR stream-drop-rate spikes -> abort rotation and rollback certs from backup: `cert-rotator rollback rot-20240910`
5) Post-rotation: run quick smoke across SDKs (python, js) and restart long-lived streams where applicable
6) If Dedicated tenant reports mTLS failures -> open priority ticket and mark tenant for manual cert pin update
```
sam.sre: Metrics note: we'll temporarily relax control-plane SLO p99 from 200ms -> 400ms for a 30m window during the rollout so automated SLO alerts don't trigger noisy paging. This does not change customer SLA; it's only a monitoring suppression.
maria.mgmt: Confirmed. I'll annotate the incident tracker and set the monitoring suppression window.
paul.ops: I'll post a notice in #platform-ops and ping partner-integrations.
sam.sre: TL;DR: emergency TLS cert rotation 2024-09-10 01:30-02:00 UTC, canaries 01:25/01:35, exclusion for loadtests, rollback on auth errors or stream-drop spikes. Bridge link will be shared 15m before. Ping here if you need the bridge link or to observe.
oncall: ack :white_check_mark:
